examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The activity of one support ticket, newest first: an SLA breach with a clock icon in danger, a status change, an assignment with a note in the default slot, and the ticket being opened.

examples.name: Groups
examples.summary: A deployment history grouped by day with Timeline.Group, each deploy's outcome as its severity and icon.

examples.name: Severities
examples.summary: One event per severity, as dots and as icons side by side; most events stay neutral so the coloured ones stand out.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The same three events at small (a side panel or drawer) and medium (a page body).

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: Three placeholder events while the history loads; the list is aria-busy and a screen reader hears Loading activity.

examples.name: With marker
examples.summary: An audit trail where the people matter: the marker slot holds a small Avatar of each actor.
